notes: 82 cards examined against Plates 31-37, 55-56, 68, 70, 75-81, 91-94, 97, 101, 180-184 and the muscle tables (p. 219-224, 270-271). Divisions rows whose reason ends with a bracketed note restate part names the card already carries under Origin/Insertion/Action; they are included so every divided muscle has one consolidated Divisions row, and can be dropped if only strictly new information is wanted. Confidence netter-inferred: trapezius (Netter does not name descending/transverse/ascending parts), superior constrictor (only the glossopharyngeal part is labelled) and middle constrictor (chondro-/ceratopharyngeal parts are not labelled). No Divisions proposed where Netter shows none: temporalis, medial pterygoid, orbicularis oris, buccinator, platysma, levator labii superioris (Netter only mentions a 'zygomatic head of levator labii superioris' in passing in the levator anguli oris row), levator labii superioris alaeque nasi, scalenes (only 'slips of origin'), genioglossus, extraocular recti and obliques, palatal and longitudinal pharyngeal muscles. After the synonyms are applied these parent cards keep no mesh of their own and become card-only parents of their part cards: occipitofrontalis, orbicularis-oculi, lateral-pterygoid, cricothyroid, suboccipital-muscles, rectus-capitis-anterior-lateralis; digastric keeps only the intermediate tendon and masseter only the masseteric fascia. If parent cards must keep a mesh, skip those synonym entries. New cards without a mesh in the model: oblique-arytenoid, cricopharyngeus and the four intrinsic tongue muscles. Model label 'Temporoparietalis muscle' is left unmapped: Netter neither labels nor tables it. 'Spinalis capitis muscle' stays on semispinalis-capitis (Netter does not label it; it normally blends with semispinalis capitis). 'Trochlea of superior oblique muscle', 'Intermediate tendon of digastric muscle', 'Masseteric fascia', 'Subtendinous bursa of trapezius muscle' and the two trapezius part labels stay on their parent cards. Netter names but not carded (no model mesh, outside head-and-neck core): iliocostalis cervicis, rotatores cervicis, intertransversarii, the accessory petropharyngeus bundle, auricularis anterior/superior/posterior as separate cards (covered by the Divisions row on auricular-muscles), nasalis parts, omohyoid bellies and sternocleidomastoid heads as separate cards (single mesh each; covered by Divisions rows). The five non-muscle structures the model files under the muscle system (epicranial aponeurosis, common tendinous ring, tarsi, temporal fascia, investing fascia) reuse the Origin/Insertion labels for their attachments.
